hotelDesc.overview:
Experience Luxury and Comfort at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor

Nestled just 25 kilometers from the vibrant city center of Nha Trang, Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor offers a tranquil retreat with easy access to the bustling attractions and pristine beaches of Vietnam’s coastal paradise. Opened in 2024, this modern oasis boasts state-of-the-art facilities and a sleek, contemporary design that promises a memorable stay for every guest. Whether you're arriving from the airport, just 20 minutes away, or exploring the local area, the hotel’s prime location ensures convenience and relaxation in equal measure. With a spacious inventory of 620 beautifully appointed rooms, Aquamarine Cam Ranh is perfect for families, couples, and travelers seeking comfort and style. The hotel welcomes children aged 3 to 5 to stay free of charge, making it an ideal destination for family vacations. Check-in begins at 3:00 PM, allowing guests to settle in and unwind, while check-out is gracefully scheduled until 12:00 PM, giving you ample time to enjoy your morning. Recently renovated in 2024, the hotel combines fresh elegance with top-tier amenities, ensuring a luxurious experience from the moment you arrive.

Exciting Entertainment Facilities at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor

Discover a vibrant array of entertainment options designed to enhance your stay at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor. Guests can indulge in relaxing treatments at the luxurious spa and salon, perfect for unwinding after a day of exploration. For those seeking leisure and fun, the games room offers a variety of engaging activities suitable for all ages, ensuring memorable moments with family and friends. Additionally, the resort features charming shops and a gift/souvenir shop, allowing guests to browse unique local products and keepsakes to take home as a reminder of their unforgettable experience.

Exciting Sports Facilities at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor

Discover a vibrant array of sports and recreational amenities designed to keep you active and entertained during your stay at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor. For fitness enthusiasts, the hotel offers a well-equipped free fitness center and a dedicated yoga room, perfect for maintaining your workout routine in a serene setting. Dive into the outdoor pool or unwind at the poolside bar, where you can enjoy refreshing drinks after a swim. For water sports lovers, the resort provides exhilarating motorized water sports options, ideal for adrenaline-pumping adventures on the sea. Beyond the pool area, guests can explore the expansive water park, featuring fun-filled attractions suitable for all ages. The private beach offers a tranquil escape for sunbathing, beach volleyball, or simply soaking in the stunning coastal views. For those seeking friendly competition, table tennis tables are available to enjoy a lively game with friends or family. Whether relaxing on the beach, engaging in water sports, or staying active at the fitness facilities, Aquamarine Cam Ranh promises an exciting and dynamic sports experience for every guest.

Exceptional Convenience Facilities at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor

Discover the ultimate comfort and ease during your stay at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor, where a range of thoughtful convenience facilities are at your fingertips. Enjoy the flexibility of 24-hour room service and daily housekeeping, ensuring your space remains fresh and tailored to your needs at any time. For your convenience, the hotel offers reliable free Wi-Fi in all rooms and public areas, keeping you connected whether you're relaxing in your room or exploring the vibrant surroundings. Additional amenities include a dedicated concierge service to assist with your travel plans and inquiries, a convenient convenience store for everyday essentials, and luggage storage to keep your belongings secure. For guests who smoke, a designated smoking area is provided to ensure comfort for all. Whether you're here for leisure or business, Aquamarine Cam Ranh offers a seamless experience with facilities designed to enhance your stay.

Convenient Transport Facilities at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor

Guests at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor enjoy a range of convenient transport options to enhance their stay. The hotel offers a secure onsite car park, allowing visitors to park their vehicles with ease and peace of mind. For those preferring local transportation, a reliable taxi service is readily available, providing quick and comfortable transfers to explore the beautiful surroundings of Nha Trang and beyond. Additionally, the hotel provides self-parking facilities that are free of charge, making it effortless for guests to come and go without any hassle. Whether arriving by car or seeking convenient access to nearby attractions, the transport facilities at Aquamarine Cam Ranh ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience from the moment you arrive.

Luxurious Comfort and Modern Amenities at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor

Experience ultimate relaxation in our elegantly appointed rooms, featuring air conditioning to keep you cool and comfortable throughout your stay. Each room offers a spacious separate living area, perfect for unwinding after a day of exploration. Step out onto the balcony or terrace to enjoy scenic views and fresh air, creating a perfect retreat within your accommodation. For your convenience, complimentary bottled water, instant coffee, and tea are provided, ensuring you stay refreshed at all times. Indulge in the plush linens and blackout curtains that guarantee restful nights, while modern toiletries and a hair dryer are thoughtfully included to enhance your comfort. The well-equipped bathroom provides all essentials, complemented by a refrigerator for your convenience. Whether you're relaxing in your room or preparing for a night out, the thoughtful amenities like bathrobes, toiletries, and a television make your stay both luxurious and effortless at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor.

Exquisite Dining Experiences at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor

At Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor, guests are treated to a diverse array of dining options designed to satisfy every palate. Start your day with a sumptuous breakfast buffet featuring a variety of international and local flavors, including hearty continental options and fresh, local ingredients. For those seeking a quick caffeine fix or a relaxing coffee break, the on-site coffee shop offers a cozy ambiance with expertly brewed beverages. The resort’s halal restaurant ensures that guests can enjoy delicious, authentic halal cuisine in a welcoming environment. For ultimate convenience and comfort, 24-hour room service is available, allowing guests to indulge in their favorite dishes in the privacy of their own rooms at any time. Daily housekeeping ensures that your stay remains pristine and comfortable, creating a seamless and enjoyable experience. Whether dining in the restaurant, grabbing a snack at the coffee shop, or enjoying a meal in your room, Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor promises a delightful culinary journey tailored to your needs.

Elegant Room Options at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor

Discover a variety of thoughtfully designed rooms at Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor, each tailored to provide a comfortable and memorable stay. Choose from the Deluxe Ocean King View with Balcony, offering 48 square meters of space with a luxurious King Bed, or opt for the Deluxe Ocean Twin View with Balcony, also spanning 48 square meters with two Single Beds. For those seeking more spacious accommodations, the Executive Suite Ocean View provides a generous 100 square meters, featuring either a King Bed or two Sofa Beds, perfect for families or travelers desiring extra room. The Senior Deluxe Twin Room offers 56 square meters with two Single Beds, ensuring ample space for relaxation, while the Deluxe Triple Room with Balcony and Sea View, at 48 square meters, accommodates a Double Bed or Single Bed for added flexibility. Booking these rooms through Agoda guarantees you the best prices available, allowing you to enjoy luxurious comfort without breaking the bank. The platform offers a seamless, hassle-free booking experience, making it easy to secure your ideal room in advance. Whether you're planning a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or a business trip, Agoda’s user-friendly service ensures your stay at Aquamarine Cam Ranh is both affordable and effortless.

Discover the Tranquil Beauty of Cam Hải Đông in Nha Trang

This peaceful fishing village is renowned for its tranquil atmosphere, making it an ideal destination for travelers seeking relaxation away from bustling city life. Stroll along the soft sandy shores, breathe in the fresh sea breeze, and enjoy breathtaking sunsets that paint the sky with hues of orange and pink. The area also boasts charming local eateries serving fresh seafood, giving visitors a taste of authentic Vietnamese coastal cuisine.

Seamless Journey from Cam Ranh International Airport to Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor

Traveling from Cam Ranh International Airport to the luxurious Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor is a smooth and convenient journey, ensuring you start your vacation in comfort. Upon arrival at Cam Ranh Airport, which is approximately 10 kilometers from the resort, guests can opt for a private transfer or a taxi for a hassle-free trip. The drive typically takes around 15 to 20 minutes, during which you’ll enjoy scenic views of the coastline and lush landscapes. Many local taxi services are available right outside the terminal, offering affordable fixed-rate fares to the resort. For added convenience, pre-arranged private transfers can be booked in advance through the hotel or online, providing a personalized and stress-free arrival experience. For those looking for a more economical option, shuttle services and ride-hailing apps like Grab are readily accessible from the airport. These services offer quick and reliable transportation directly to Aquamarine Cam Ranh - By Swandor. Once you arrive, you'll be greeted by the resort’s welcoming staff and the stunning vistas of Cam Hải Đông, setting the perfect tone for your relaxing getaway. Whether you choose a private transfer or a shared ride, the journey from the airport to the resort is short, scenic, and designed to make your arrival as comfortable as possible.

The tranquil ambiance of this beach provides a serene escape from the bustling city life, allowing visitors to relax and reconnect with nature just minutes from the hotel.
